\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\newcommand\compactmathprobe[2]{%
  \setbox0=\hbox{#2}%
  \typeout{COMPACT-RENDERER #1: wd=\the\wd0; ht=\the\ht0; dp=\the\dp0}%
}
\begin{document}
\compactmathprobe{x-text}{$\textstyle x$}
\compactmathprobe{x-display}{$\displaystyle x$}
\compactmathprobe{fraction-text}{$\textstyle\frac{1}{x}$}
\compactmathprobe{fraction-display}{$\displaystyle\frac{1}{x}$}
\compactmathprobe{alpha}{$\alpha$}
\compactmathprobe{cdot}{$\cdot$}
\compactmathprobe{dollar-one}{$\$ 1$}
\compactmathprobe{relation}{$P=(x,y)$}
\compactmathprobe{P}{$P$}
\compactmathprobe{equal}{$=$}
\compactmathprobe{sin}{$\sin x$}
\compactmathprobe{sin-word}{$\mathop{\mathrm{sin}}\nolimits$}
\compactmathprobe{scriptsize}{{\scriptsize$2x+3y\le10$}}
\compactmathprobe{large-t}{{\large$t$}}
\compactmathprobe{times-one}{$\times 1$}
\compactmathprobe{scaled-times-one}{\scalebox{.5}{$\times 1$}}
\compactmathprobe{five-point-times-one}{{\fontsize{5}{6}\selectfont$\times 1$}}
\compactmathprobe{mantissa-one}{$1$}
\compactmathprobe{mantissa-nine-eight}{$9.8$}
\compactmathprobe{mantissa-one-two-three}{$1.23$}
